title.narrative: UN Peace Support Facility for Yemen – Phase 3

description.narrative: Building on the achievements of its first two phases, UN PSF Phase 3 will continue to support the Special Envoy and the UN Resident Coordinator in their efforts to revitalise and sustain Yemen’s peace process. Phase 3 will focus on delivering fast, flexible, and catalytic initiatives that generate tangible, rapid, and lasting improvements in the daily lives of Yemenis. These efforts aim to reinforce public confidence in the peace process and foster a locally anchored foundation of support for po

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).
